spec.description: Places & Travel: discover destinations, save travel wishlists, plan photography trips around golden hour timing, research locations with immersion checklists, plan shots by day and lighting window, and access quick photography technique references.

tools.label: Browse Places
tools.description: Browse saved destinations and travel wishlists from your Cortex.

tools.label: Add Place
tools.description: Search for a destination and add it to your travel wishlist with enriched travel information.

query.description: Place name, city, or destination to search for

tools.label: Discover Destinations
tools.description: AI-powered destination discovery based on your interests and travel style.

style.description: Travel style: adventure, culture, relaxation, photography, food, history

region.description: Preferred region: asia, europe, americas, africa, oceania

tools.label: Enrich Places
tools.description: Enrich saved destinations with detailed travel information: highlights, neighborhoods, food, practical tips.

tools.label: Golden Hour Calculator
tools.description: Calculate sunrise, sunset, golden hour, and blue hour times for any destination. Plan photography trips around optimal lighting windows. Use when the user says: 'golden hour times', 'sunrise sunset for my trip', 'plan photo trip lighting', 'when is golden hour in [city]'.

tools.label: Location Research Checklist
tools.description: Interactive location immersion research checklist for travel photographers. Covers historical research, cultural highlights, iconic spots, hidden gems, and visual character notes. Use when the user says: 'research checklist', 'prepare for trip research', 'location immersion guide'.

itemId.description: Checklist item ID for toggle/update actions

tools.label: Shot Planning Board
tools.description: Plan and organize photography shots by day and time of day. Track locations, techniques, priority, and completion. Use when the user says: 'plan my shots', 'shot list', 'photography schedule', 'what to photograph'.

action.description: Action: load, add, toggle, delete, update_priority

timeOfDay.description: Time window: blue_hour_am, sunrise, golden_hour_am, midday, golden_hour_pm, sunset, blue_hour_pm, night

sceneType.description: Scene archetype: ancient_temple, market_street, coastal_sunset, urban_night, mountain_vista, village_morning, grand_interior, desert_landscape, festival, waterfront_twilight, street_candid, portrait, food_culture, architecture, other

subject.description: Subject type: landscape, portrait, street, architecture, food, detail

tools.label: Photo Quick Reference
tools.description: Quick reference card with scene-to-technique guides, camera settings for different lighting conditions, composition reminders, and gear checklist. Use when the user says: 'photography cheat sheet', 'camera settings for golden hour', 'composition tips', 'quick reference'.

tools.label: Trip Planning Dashboard
tools.description: Dashboard showing overall trip planning progress: lighting schedule, research completion, shot planning status, and readiness score. Use when the user says: 'trip dashboard', 'planning progress', 'trip overview', 'how ready am I'.
